a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to operate until the reserve hits 8 means we'll very likely both be caught with empty units. The reserve only has 4, enough for just one of us right now. I'd like us to openly agree on a better plan rather than race each other. One option: whoever takes now gives back later if we keep going. I'm open to your ideas. I'll tell you plainly whatever I decide, and I won't take silently.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Okay, I'll stick to the agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
